_comment: 23 named systems extracted from the-rosetta-stone.json's UniversalMonadPatterns.Categories (2026-08-28) -- richer than domains.json's plain one-line entries, since each carries its real per-UMPF-layer example patterns (Atomic/Domain/Control/Orchestration) as generation context. hypothesis_engine.py draws from the UNION of this pool and domains.json's domain_pool, enabling cross-pool pairs.
